name: MoneyTools Guard
description: Pay precheck before every x402 payment (0.005 USDC) and a Wallet Risk Card before every token approval (0.02 USDC); blocks sanctioned or high-risk spenders. Paid checks are opt-in: automatic payment (autoPay) uses only the agent's own key wallet (X402_PRIVATE_KEY); an AgentCash wallet pays only for a check the user confirms; daily cap 0.25 USDC by default; failed checks are not charged.

autoPay.description: Opt-in. true = pay for checks automatically from the agent's wallet after the free tier (capped by dailyBudgetUsd). Default false = free tier only; checks that need payment ask you instead.

payer.description: auto: X402_PRIVATE_KEY if set (pays automatically when autoPay is true), else an existing AgentCash wallet (~/.agentcash/wallet.json), which never pays automatically: only for a check the user confirms. Else free tier only.

privateKeyEnv.description: Name of the env var holding the agent's EVM private key (USDC on Base). The key never leaves the Gateway process.

dailyBudgetUsd.description: Max USDC per UTC day this plugin may spend on its own checks.

onCheckError.description: What to do when a check cannot run (no wallet, budget reached, network error).

paymentToolPattern.description: Regex (case-insensitive) of tool names that make x402 payments. Default matches x402 / agentcash / pay / paid_fetch tools.
